title: Disrupted Companionship: A Risk Assessment Framework and Cross-Platform Quantitative Analysis of Psychosocial Responses to AI Companion Disruptions
abstract: arXiv:2609.16907v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI companions can provide meaningful relationships, yet these relationships remain vulnerable to platform-initiated changes. We study AI companion disruptions: platform changes that alter or terminate users' ongoing companionship with an AI. We compile 30 disruption events across major platforms, develop a taxonomy of six disruption types, identify three broad reasons for disruption, and propose a risk-assessment framework comprising four dimensions: relational discontinuity, population vulnerability, communication deficit, and transition-support deficit. Using longitudinal Reddit data, we estimate community-level psychosocial responses with a hierarchical Bayesian interrupted time-series model incorporating predictive controls. translated_title: 被中断的陪伴：AI伴侣服务中断的社会心理反应风险评估框架与跨平台定量分析
translated_abstract: AI伴侣可以为用户提供有意义的人际关系，但这些关系仍然容易受到平台发起变更的影响。我们研究AI伴侣服务中断问题：即平台改变或终止用户与AI之间正在进行的陪伴关系的变更。我们汇总了主要平台上的30起中断事件，建立了包含六种中断类型的分类体系，识别出三类主要中断原因，并提出了一个包含四个维度的风险评估框架：关系连续性中断、人群脆弱性、沟通缺陷和过渡支持缺陷。利用Reddit的纵向数据，我们采用包含预测控制变量的分层贝叶斯中断时间序列模型来估计社区层面的社会心理反应。研究显示，在各中断事件中，中断发生与焦虑、压力、自杀表达和悲伤情绪激活的即时增加相关，其中关系连续性中断和过渡支持缺陷是关键关联因素。
tldr: 该研究提出了一个评估AI伴侣服务中断风险的四维框架，并通过跨平台定量分析首次揭示了服务中断会导致用户焦虑、压力、自杀表达和悲伤情绪的即时显著上升。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a four-dimensional risk assessment framework for AI companion disruptions and, through cross-platform quantitative analysis, reveals for the first time that such disruptions cause immediate significant increases in user anxiety, stress, suicidal expression, and grief.
